Name: Cuter Void Chickens
Author: SkylarkL
Description:
Reskins the Void Chickens to be cute and contented instead of foreboding and grumpy! Now with an update key.

Most other mods should work with this - the only ones that will conflict will be ones that also replace the Void Chicken sprite.

[size=3]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
